versions.changelog: Opt-in --dispatch runs steps in each skill's own MCP server; honest approval gates and rollback; clone_and_test works on real vSphere.
Roles for network callers (HLD §18): declares role metadata so vmware-policy 1.24.0 can limit each token to a role's tools and targets.
mcp --transport https: serve MCP over HTTPS with bearer tokens (HLD §16)
mcp --expose read / --allow-write: offer only read tools plus chosen write tools
plan_workflow renamed create_workflow_from_template; catalog uses vks issue_*_kubeconfig; saved workflows translated; upgrade with vmware-vks 3.0.0
Companion tools at their 2.0 names; saved workflows with pre-2.0 names are translated
reset_vcenter_alarm labelled high risk
Destructive MCP tools preview by default (confirm=False) and state their blast radius; confirm=True refuses on blockers or unreadable measurements. Requires vmware-policy>=1.17.0.
CLI reads are audited under their MCP tool names; every CLI command declares what it reaches (needs vmware-policy 1.15.0)
design catalog covers all thirteen companion skills
investigate_alert and compliance_scan now call registered tools with real parameters; template steps are checked against the companions' registries.

A step whose dispatch returns {"error": ...} or an isError result is now a failed step, on the forward and the rollback path — previously such a workflow reported completed and rollback then refused it. Found on a live vCenter.
BREAKING: a custom workflow whose destructive steps carry no approval gate is rejected instead of running with a warning, and patch_deployment requires an explicit username.
fix: run the suite on a non-UTF-8 machine, and stop one skill answering for another
Second-round fixes from the 2026-08-30 VCF 9.1 re-test; vmware-policy floor raised to 1.11.0 (the engine no longer fails open when rules.yaml cannot be read).
Parameter descriptions now reach the MCP JSON schema (0% -> 100% coverage); additionalProperties closed; vmware-policy floor raised to 1.10.0.
Fixes the server's self-reported version and the advertised tool count; adds a Claude Code plugin manifest.
Moved to vmware-skills GitHub org; MCP Registry namespace → io.github.vmware-skills. Links updated.
Remove read-only switch and approval tiers; read/write authz delegated to RBAC. Plus accumulated fixes since 1.8.5.
A failure that is returned is now audited as a failure, and certificate/URL detail no longer reaches the agent. Both fixes v1.8.4 announced were incomplete.
Teaching error messages, domain exceptions no longer redacted on the way to the agent, and tool descriptions that state when to use each tool and what to call next.
Family version alignment; the credential env-var override lands in the skills that have per-target credentials
MCP server moved into the package namespace — fixes two skills in one environment silently overwriting each other's server; agent-guardrails.md for local/small models now ships in every skill
Read-only mode now documented on every surface that teaches it (SKILL.md, setup-guide, capabilities)
Read-only mode (9 orchestration write tools withheld), declared environments; avi added to the design catalog (69 tools across 8 skills); new vmware-pilot CLI entry point
v1.6.2 MCP Registry registration (mcp-name marker)
v1.6.1 family version alignment
backlog finish: cancel_workflow, templates split
backlog: remove dead states
never report work that wasn't performed
Security hardening: safe error handling, TLS/path/permission fixes

v1.5.17 - Pilot v2 architecture follow-ups: investigate_alert template (causal-chain root-cause workflow with 4-criteria checkpoint), review_workflow MCP tool (structural sanity check), parallel_group step type with group_id field, dispatch contract docs.

v1.5.16 - Enterprise Harness Engineering alignment: 5-level automation taxonomy (L1-L5) in capabilities.md, expert judgment encoded into Common Workflows pre-flight sections, causal-chain investigation protocol shared across aria/monitor/aiops, family version bump.
v1.5.14: code review fixes by @yjs-2026 + Snyk E005 disclaimer

vmware-pilot 1.5.3

- Documentation update only; no code or functional changes.
- SKILL.md refreshed with existing workflows, scenarios, and companion skills.
- No changes to installer, compatibility, or tool definitions.
- Upgrade is optional for current users.

vmware-pilot 1.5.2

- Expanded compatibility section to clarify orchestration model (no direct vCenter/NSX credentials, no webhooks, no background services).
- Added clearer description of state persistence, approval gates, and rollback behavior.
- Explicitly listed transitive dependency (only vmware-policy) and reaffirmed no post-install scripts.
- Updated compatibility notes to highlight that companion skills handle their own authentication.
- No changes to workflow logic or APIs; documentation improvements only.

- Added a disclaimer clarifying that this project is community-maintained, open-source, and not affiliated with or endorsed by VMware, Inc. or Broadcom Inc.
- Mentioned the MIT license and linked the GitHub repository in the disclaimer.
- No changes to features, templates, or technical functionality.

Anthropic best practices: [READ]/[WRITE] prefixes, Broadcom author attestation
Security routing fixes and vmware-policy clarity; NSX auth fix for special char passwords
v1.4.4: vmware-avi family integration, cross-skill routing, sanitize coverage, safety tests
